keyset.title: Keyset
keyset.profile_help: Scegli una configuraziun de la ciaf salvà
keyset.profile_delete_prompt: Elimina “%s”? Chestu pœu no vèss disfà.
keyset.profile_new_tip: Crea un profil copià di ligam atuai
keyset.compare_hint: Seleziuna i diferenzi per copiar de la funt in del profil atif. I aziun mancant de la funt pœden no vèss copià.
keyset.compare_no_differences: Chesti profil g’han i stess ligam.
keyset.compare_missing_source_hint: Chesta aziun g’ha nissun vincul de surgent e la pœu no vèss copiada.
keyset.compare_source_tip: Ciclo travers i profil de surgent
keyset.compare_changed: I prufil sun stà cambià. Esaminà i diferenzi agiurnà prima de candidàs.
keyset.search_syntax_tip: Dupera #categuria, @mod, $chiave o {mudificatur}. Cita di nomm cun spazi, par esempi @"Collocaziun precis del blocch". Cumbina i filter cunt i nomm di aziun.
keyset.keyboard_hint: Seleziuna un'aziun, e dopu fai clic sü un tast o sü un pulsant del mouse
keyset.keyboard_tab_tip: Mustra i input de la tastiera
keyset.no_bindings: Nissun ligam currispunt a chesti filter.
keyset.capture_binding_tip: Cliccà, e dopu premet un tast o un pulsant del mous
keyset.virtual_key_tip: Clicca per filtrar per %s; menter se cattura, asegna chestu input
keyset.capture_prompt: Assegnaziun de %s · Escape scancela tüt el vincul
keyset.reset_all_prompt: Tüt i ligam turnaran ai luur predefinì.
keyset.error_generic: L'è minga stà pusibel salvà chesta modifica. Cuntrula el registr e pruva ancamò.
keyset.error.shared_conflict: I impostaziun sun stà mudificà en un olter esempi de Minecraft. Revis i valur agiurnà e pruva ancamò.
keyset.error.shared_sync: Pœu minga rinfrescà i impostaziun cundivis. I tò ligam atuai sun mantegnuu.
keyset.error.recovered: Un profil dannegià l’è stà recuperà del backup.
keyset.error.storage: L'archiviaziun del profil pœu minga vèss lett o scrivuu. Cuntrula el registr del giœugh.
keyset.conflict_replace_tip: Sliga chesta cumbinaziun de tüt i olter aziun en cunflit
keyset.conflict_swap_tip: Spusta l'oltra aziun al vincul precedent de chesta aziun: %s
keyset.conflict_swap_unavailable: Dispunibel dopu l'asegnaziun de una ciaf che l'è en cunflit cunt un'oltra aziun
keyset.conflict_gone: Chestu cunflit l’è stà risolt o mudificà.
keyset.conflict_changed: I ligam sun cambià en un oltra finestra. Rivedi ancamò el cunflit.
keyset.auto_profile_requires_world: Unisci a un mund o a un server per impostar un profil automatich
keyset.auto_profile_set_tip: Dupera %s per chestu mund o per chestu server
keyset.selection_hint: Premi un tast o un pulsant del mouse · Escape se deslega.
keyset.footer_hint: I cambiament salvan subit · Escape sara l'editur
keyset.native_hint: Tast rapid MaLiLib · premet una cumbinaziun, e dopu liberà i sò tast
keyset.native_capture_prompt: Premi una cumbinaziun, e dopu liberà · Escape desliga
keyset.transfer_import_prompt: Impurtar profil de %s file JSON in de la cartella de trasferiment Keyset cundivisa? I profil istess verran saltà.
keyset.transfer_exported: Profil esportà in de la cartella de trasferiment Keyset cundivisa. Olter compilaziun de Minecraft pœden avegh access.
keyset.transfer_duplicate: Nissun nœuf prufil. Chesti profil sun giamò present.
keyset.transfer_empty: Met prima i file JSON del profil esportà in de la cartella de trasferiment del Keyset condivisa.
keyset.appearance_row_height_label: Alteza de la riga de aziun
keyset.visibility_hint: Ascünd o restaura i mod e i categurì senza mudificar i tast rapid
keyset.visibility_hint_count: Seziun ascüs: %s. I tast rapid restan atif; i cunflit g’han ancamò di aziun ascüs.
keyset.visibility_hide_section: Hide this section: collapse it and remove its highlights from the keyboard. Hotkeys will keep working.
keyset.visibility_hidden_notice: Section hidden: %1$s. Its hotkeys still work in game.
keyset.visibility_explanation: I aziun ascüs restan ligà e atif
keyset.visibility_hide_tip: Scünd dal editur; i tast rapid restan atif
keyset.visibility_search_syntax_tip: Dupera #categoria o @mod per cambiar e cercar in del elenc. Mett di nomm cun spazi intra virgolett.
keyset.profile_scope_detach_tip: Dupera di profil separà per chesta istanza. I tò profil sun copià al prim üs; i profil locai esistent sun restaurà. I profil cundivis restan dispunibel.
keyset.profile_scope_attach_tip: Recunnett ai profil cundivis senza fusionar. I tò profil separà sun cunservà per dopu.
keyset.profile_scope_detached: Profil separà abilì per chesta istanza
keyset.themes_empty: Save your current colors as a theme.
keyset.themes_exported: Theme exported to %s and copied to the clipboard.
keyset.themes_import_hint: Import theme JSON from the clipboard, or place a theme file in %s.
keyset.themes_no_import: No theme JSON found in the clipboard or transfer folder.
keyset.preview_scroll_hint: Drag the bar to view the rest of the keyboard
keyset.legend_fn_hint: Fn is controlled by the keyboard hardware. It is shown for reference and cannot be bound separately.

keyset.appearance_mouse_body_hint: Color of the top and side mouse shell. Button colors follow their binding state.
keyset.bottom_hint: Select a key, then move it left or right.
keyset.bottom_fit_hint: Other key widths adjust to fit. Click the width to restore Auto.
keyset.section_hidden_tip: This section is hidden. Use + to restore it. Its hotkeys still work in game.
keyset.section_unbind_prompt: Are you sure you want to unbind all keys in "%1$s"? This will clear bindings for all %2$s actions in the current profile, including actions outside the current search. You can undo this change.
keyset.section_unbind_title: Unbind all keys in this section?
keyset.themes_copy_hint: Copy this resource-pack theme to your saved themes to edit it independently.
keyset.themes_copied: Theme copied to your saved themes.
